description: Link a fixing PR. Record a pull request that fixes a queue item. An item can carry several PRs: each call ADDS one (re-linking a linked PR is a no-op), `unlink: true` removes one, and `prNumber: null` clears them all. `connectorData.github.prs` lists them; `github.pr` is the primary one (newest…

handle.description: A resource path identifier — an opaque `xxx_<ULID>` id (~30 chars) or the resource's `name`/`key`. 1–128 characters; the upper bound matches the longest name/key any resource accepts, so an over-long value can never name a real row.

prNumber.description: PR number to ADD to the item's linked PRs (re-linking one already linked is a no-op). `null` unlinks EVERY PR on the item.

prUrl.description: Explicit PR URL. Required for error/alert tickets (no GitHub issue to derive the URL from).

unlink.description: Remove just this PR (`prNumber`, or `prUrl` when given) from the item instead of adding it.

name: ops_link_pr
